commands.name: search-places
commands.summary: Find places in Sweden by name. Returns the geonameid and lat/lon that the forecast and warning commands take.

commands.name: get-current-weather
commands.summary: Get the current weather (temperature and weather symbol) for a place, by geonameid.

commands.name: get-forecast
commands.summary: Get the 10-day weather forecast for a place, by geonameid. Returns one entry per day with a summary, midday values and hourly data.

commands.name: get-recent-weather
commands.summary: Get the analysed/observed weather for the past hours at a place (MESAN analysis), by geonameid.

commands.name: get-place-warnings
commands.summary: Get the most severe active warnings and advisories (level, type and count) at a lat/lon coordinate.

commands.name: get-national-warning-level
commands.summary: Get the most severe weather-warning level currently active anywhere in Sweden (e.g. YELLOW).

commands.name: list-warnings
commands.summary: List all active weather warnings and advisories in Sweden, with level, event type, area, time window and descriptions.

commands.name: search-open-data
commands.summary: Search SMHI's open-data catalog for datasets by keyword. Use query 'all' to list every dataset.

commands.name: get-open-data-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one open-data catalog dataset, by its name slug (from search-open-data).

commands.name: list-observation-stations
commands.summary: List the meteorological observation stations that measure a parameter (metobs open API). Returns station keys for get-station-observations.

commands.name: get-latest-observations-all-stations
commands.summary: Get the latest-hour observed value of a parameter from every active station in one call.

commands.name: get-station
commands.summary: Get details for one observation station and parameter: owner, position history, active status and available data periods.

commands.name: get-station-observations
commands.summary: Get observed values (timestamp in epoch ms, value, quality code) for one station, parameter and time period.

commands.name: search-knowledge-bank
commands.summary: Search SMHI's knowledge bank (Kunskapsbanken) articles on meteorology, hydrology, oceanography and climate. Optionally filter by topic.

commands.name: get-knowledge-article
commands.summary: Read a knowledge-bank article, by topic and slug (from the search-knowledge-bank url /kunskapsbanken/{topic}/{slug}).

commands.name: get-news-article
commands.summary: Read an SMHI news article, by slug (path segment after /nyheter/nyheter/).
